notes: Direct FSBO-curious owner reaching out to interview an agent about selling their Cobble Hill brownstone. A lead to win. shouldExtractParty=true. The owner's own property address IS present and gradeable.

input.subject: Thinking about selling our brownstone - can we talk?
input.bodyText:
Hi Ryan,

My wife and I own the townhouse at 312 Warren St in Cobble Hill and we've been thinking it might be time to downsize now that the kids are grown. We're not in a rush, but we'd like to understand what it might be worth in today's market and what the process looks like.

A neighbor recommended you. Could we set up a time for you to come by and give us your honest take? We haven't spoken to any other agents yet.

Thanks,
Harold Weiss
(718) 555-0164
